description: Return top high-yield savings rates with freshness and attribution. Answers only from the editor-approved snapshot; before its first release it returns no ranked rates and says so (approval_status: not_yet_approved). approvedOnly makes the requirement explicit. detail=full adds every listed account marked verified or tracked, best picks, movers, history and a headline summary.

approvedOnly.description: Require an editor-approved HYSA snapshot. The default tool already answers only from the approved release; before its first release it returns no ranked rates (approval_status: not_yet_approved).

detail.description: summary (default) adds list_counts. full (savings) adds the complete shared build: accounts (verified and tracked, each marked), best_picks, movers, history and summary. rates stays verified-only either way.
